label: ERROR_DEPENDENCE_1: every assertion expresses the shared condition
definition: SharedOnly ν C means ν C = 1: every local condition holds almost surely, so each assertion is true exactly when the shared condition holds. The assertions then express one event (the issue's 300 restatements of H), and their errors are entirely common-mode.
